allowedSourceMaterial.overview: After an adventurer known as the Asian Hawk steals a mysterious sword known to be a piece of the Armour of God, a magical suit of armour that dates back to the Crusades, a cult of Satanic monks kidnap his ex-girlfriend and demand he turn over the sword and recover the rest of the armour.

facts.title: Armour of God

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can Hawk outwit a mysterious cult and assemble the fabled relic before time runs out for his kidnapped ex?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After adventurer Asian Hawk steals a legendary Crusades-era sword, a cult of Satanic monks abducts his ex-girlfriend to force him to track down the remaining pieces of the magical Armour of God.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, comedic, and lighthearted action-adventure that offers high excitement with easy, low-effort viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan, this globe-trotting 1986 comedy adventure delivers high-spirited physical action, inventive set pieces, and a breezily fast-moving pace.
